user.title: Connect to Signal REST API
user.description: Connect to an existing Signal add-on or standalone REST API. Link or register an account in that backend before continuing.

settings.title: Destinations and receiving
settings.description: Choose notification destinations and permitted senders/groups by name, or enter identifiers manually. Group events require BOTH an allowed sender and group. Empty sender lists deny all incoming events. Selecting a test destination sends one fixed test message when you submit; leave it blank to send nothing. In normal/native mode, disable other receivers and automatic receiving in the backend first.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect Signal account
reconfigure.description: The existing account must be linked on the new endpoint.

addon.title: Running Signal add-on detected
addon.description: Connect over the internal Docker network on port 8080, or enter a URL manually.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Signal REST API. Check its URL and backend logs.
error.invalid_auth: Proxy authentication failed. Check your credentials.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without credentials, query or fragment.
error.unsupported_server: The server must expose v2 sending and a recognized execution mode.
error.no_destinations: Select or enter at least one destination.
error.account_missing: The selected account is no longer linked to this backend.
error.test_failed: The test send failed or its delivery is uncertain. No settings were saved. Check the backend URL, proxy credentials and account linkage. Test sending is now disabled; select a destination again only if you intend to send another test.

abort.no_accounts: No accounts found. Link your phone in the backend, then add this integration again.
abort.already_configured: This backend and account are already configured.
abort.account_missing: The selected account is no longer linked to this backend.
abort.invalid_auth: Proxy authentication failed. Check your credentials.

settings.title: Destinations and receiving
settings.description: Choose notification destinations and permitted senders/groups by name, or enter identifiers manually. Group events require BOTH an allowed sender and group. Empty sender lists deny all incoming events. Selecting a test destination sends one fixed test message when you submit; leave it blank to send nothing. In normal/native mode, disable other receivers and automatic receiving in the backend first.

groups.title: Manage Signal groups
groups.description: Changes apply directly to Signal. When creating a group, you can also add it as a notification destination. Incoming messages still require separate authorization under Destinations and receiving.

group_create.title: Create a Signal group
group_create.description: Enter numbers in international format or Signal UUIDs. Leave the timer empty and permissions/link state unchanged to preserve existing settings. Backend permissions and version support determine which operations are available. You will review the change before it is sent.

group_edit.title: Configure Signal group
group_edit.description: Enter numbers in international format or Signal UUIDs. Leave the timer empty and permissions/link state unchanged to preserve existing settings. Backend permissions and version support determine which operations are available. You will review the change before it is sent.

group_action.title: Manage {group}
group_action.description:
Current group details (including members, administrators and invite link):

{details}

group_confirm.title: Confirm group change

error.no_destinations: Select or enter at least one destination.
error.test_failed: The test send failed or its delivery is uncertain. No settings were saved. Check the backend URL, proxy credentials and account linkage. Test sending is now disabled; select a destination again only if you intend to send another test.
error.group_read_failed: Cannot read groups. Check the connection, credentials and backend support, then try again.
error.group_missing: This group is no longer available. Select another group.
error.no_groups: No groups found. Go back to create a group.
error.invalid_group_input: Enter a non-empty name and at least one number or UUID when adding or changing people.

abort.group_saved: Group change sent successfully. Reopen options to view current group details or select notification destinations. Incoming permissions are unchanged.
abort.group_change_failed: The group change failed or its outcome is uncertain. It was not retried. Check the group in Signal and backend logs before trying again; the operation may already have been applied.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Send text, attachments or a quoted reply. Returns per-destination results when response data is requested.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Select an account; required when more than one is loaded.

recipients.name: Recipients
recipients.description: Phone numbers, UUIDs, usernames or REST group. IDs. Omit to use configured destinations.

title.name: Title
title.description: Prepended to the message, separated by a blank line.

attachments.name: Local attachments
attachments.description: Allowed local file paths. Maximum five files, 10 MiB each and 20 MiB combined.

urls.name: Attachment URLs
urls.description: Allowlisted HTTP(S) URLs. Redirect destinations must also be allowed.

text_mode.name: Text mode
text_mode.description: Use normal or Signal styled formatting.

quote_timestamp.name: Original timestamp
quote_timestamp.description: Original Signal message timestamp in milliseconds.

send_reaction.name: Send reaction
send_reaction.description: React to a specific message, or remove your reaction. No automatic retries.

recipient.name: Conversation
recipient.description: Recipient number/UUID or REST group. ID.

target_author.name: Original author
target_author.description: Sender number or UUID of the original message.

emoji.name: Emoji
emoji.description: Reaction emoji; optional when removing a reaction.

remove_reaction.name: Remove reaction
remove_reaction.description: React to a specific message, or remove your reaction. No automatic retries.

recipient.name: Conversation
recipient.description: Recipient number/UUID or REST group. ID.

target_author.name: Original author
target_author.description: Sender number or UUID of the original message.

emoji.name: Emoji
emoji.description: Reaction emoji; optional when removing a reaction.

send_alert.name: Send alert and wait for acknowledgment
send_alert.description: Send an alert and reminders until an approved reaction to the original message or expiry. Restart/reload cancels the wait.

recipient.name: Destination
recipient.description: Phone number, UUID or REST group. ID; usernames are not supported for correlation.

message.name: Alert message
message.description: Message to send and repeat in reminders.

emoji.name: Acknowledgment emoji
emoji.description: Exact emoji that acknowledges the original message.

account_author.name: Sending account UUID
account_author.description: Set if reaction events hide the sending account phone number. Not the reacting person.

expiry.name: Expiry
expiry.description: Seconds to wait after sending the original alert.

reminder_interval.name: Reminder interval
reminder_interval.description: Seconds between reminders. Set greater than expiry to disable reminders.
